init.title: Régie des Eaux Montpellier options
init.description: The water meter is read once a day at the configured time. The Régie publishes the previous day's reading overnight. When no reading happens for several days, the next reading is cumulative: smoothing spreads that consumption over the missing days (e.g. 1 m³ after 3 days without a reading → ~0.33 m³/day).

data.smooth_consumption: Smooth consumption over days without a reading
